song_craft: Voice: śānta couplets, mirror-light register (still, clear, unforced). Arc: light unobjectifiable (v1) → non-duality (v2) → positive declaration with division inside (v3) → difference uncut + bare list (v4) → mirror a-fortiori (v5) → address: You alone (v6) → paradox praised (v7) → seal: hymn names its close (v8). Sthāyin śānta throughout; adbhuta/ānanda color single verses. L4 = L3 verbatim, music named.

lines: This sevenfold good conduct — those whose other thoughts have melted, who long for the ultimate, rightly remember in the heart.
And they — O Bhairava’s own — enter the supreme abode again and again, and know the ultimate discourse of the three worlds.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sadvṛttasaptakam idaṃ galitānyacintāḥ samyak smaranti hṛdaye paramārthakāmāḥ | te bhairavīya paradhāma muhur viśanti jānanti ca trijagatīparamārthacarcām

verses.craft: Self-naming seal (remembered/entered/known — hymn closes by naming itself); bhairavīya vocative kept open; again-and-again for punar.
verses.rejected: (a) resolving address-vs-genitive → killed by UNC. (b) discourse→discussion → killed: L3 frozen.
